Name: Variable Monster Difficulty
Author: ASLaneZero
Description:
[center][size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52619/52619-1789875265-1606157720.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]

Allows the player to modify the HP, Damage, Defense, Awareness, Speed, and XP yields for all (vanilla) monsters using GMCM. Without modifying the config, monster HP, Damage, Defense and Speed are doubled, making for a much harder early game.

This mod is included in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34612]Small Mods Pack[/url] (though a download/endorse is always appreciated)!

[center][size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52619/52619-1789875258-554298532.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ (Optional, but highly recommended)[/color][/*]
[/list]
[center][size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52619/52619-1789875262-904395292.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]If installing manually, delete the previous version and extract [b][CP] Variable Monster Difficulty[/b] to your mods folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]If using Mod Organiser, load the .zip file into your mod manager of choice and install as usual.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]If using a different mod manager... do whatever it is you usually do![/color][/*]
[/list]
[center][size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52619/52619-1789875262-590616210.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]

[b]MonsterHealth[/b]
[i]Configures the multiplier for Monster HP.[/i]

[*]Doubled: 2x (Default)[/*]
[*]Quadrupled: 4x[/*]
